title: 3LivesAdvanced
description: A lightweight hardcore like survival plugin that adds a limited lives system able to configured in alot of different ways. By ShuuNaX❤️
body:
A hardcore, survival-like plugin that adds a limited lives system able to be configured in a lot of ways that you probably want! By ShuuNaX ❤️ and [anonymous] (He doesn't want to be known for making plugins!)

Note: THIS PLUGIN IS USED FOR MY SMP, SO THIS MEANS THERE MIGHT BE BUGS. GO TO THE DISCORD AND MAKE A TICKET TO TRY AND HELP YOU FIX IT. IF I CAN'T, THERE ARE OTHER ONES OUT THERE THAT YOU CAN TRY OUT!!

ASWELL, THE PLUGIN IS INSPIRED BY THE GRAIN'S LIVES SERIES AND WISPSMP (both 3-life SMP servers or concepts).

————————————————————————————————————————————————————

You can customise so much more compared to other plugins out there, but if you want a more simple version? Please just go to other ones out there; this one is simple but has a good amount of features, meaning a lot more power your server can just use for something else.

- Players will start with a configurable number of lives you set and the max amount of lives, revival lives, and losing a life after death!
- At 0 lives, players are eliminated! (BAN or SPECTATOR, configurable)
- An action bar message that appears when you join in, showing the amount of lives you have.
- LifeStars, add a life to yourself if you're missing one!
- Custom LifeStars: This plugin adds custom LifeStars, able to give you not just 1 but an infinite amount of hearts and able to make more! (Read in Config.YLM how to do it!)
- Revival book, able to be right-clicked to revive anybody of your choice!
- The power to make all of the items craftable or not!
- In TAB you can see how many lives people have!
- Fully customisable messages, recipes, sounds, behaviour, etc.

The plugin right now doesn't have any compatibility with any other plugin; it might add that in the future!
